data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English 'here' (meaning 'army, warriors') and 'buta' (meaning 'strong, fortified place'). This name represents a strong and protective figure. The name Hurlbut carries the meaning “Strong fortress” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hurlbut usually hope their child will grow to embody strong fortress and live with faith, good character and purpose.
